name: claude-loadout
description: Personal Claude Code loadout: a pre-commit secret gate and a cross-model second-opinion reviewer. Add this marketplace on any machine, install the plugins you want.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Pre-commit secret gate: a PreToolUse hook scans staged changes and blocks commits carrying secrets, plus a semantic review subagent. Zero config.

plugins.name: litellm-council
plugins.description: Cross-model council via your self-hosted LiteLLM proxy (Node-based, no MCP). Run /litellm-council:setup once (or set LITELLM_BASE_URL / LITELLM_API_KEY / LITELLM_COUNCIL_MODELS), then :second-opinion (review the current diff), :ask (any question), :debate (two rounds where models see each other's answers), :doctor (health-check the council and self-heal a dead/EOL model), or :models (browse the proxy's live catalog and re-pick the council).

plugins.name: nvidia-council
plugins.description: Cross-model council straight against NVIDIA's hosted NIM endpoint - no proxy in the path, so it works when your LiteLLM is down. Export NVIDIA_API_KEY (free nvapi- key from build.nvidia.com), run /nvidia-council:setup once, then :second-opinion (review the current diff), :ask (any question), :doctor (health-check the council and swap out a dead/EOL model), or :models (browse the live NVIDIA catalog and re-pick the council). Rate-limit aware for the free tier's ~40 req/min per key.
